research_result.description: Bright Data provides web data collection infrastructure, including SERP API, Web Unlocker API, Web Scraper API, cloud browser automation, and an official MCP server for AI agents.
research_result.credential_requirements: A default API key is created automatically upon account creation. Additional API keys can be generated in the control panel under Account Settings.

evidence.claim: Bright Data provides a recurring free tier with 5,000 credits per month without requiring a credit card.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The free tier is a recurring monthly credit allowance that applies automatically to every new account.

evidence.claim: Bright Data supports authentication using an API key sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: An API key is a secure hashed token used to authenticate with Bright Data API. We create a default key for you upon account creation automatically.

evidence.claim: Bright Data provides an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agents.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Connect it to Claude, Cursor or any MCP-compatible client, and your agent can search, scrape and read live web pages without you building or maintaining data pipelines.

evidence.claim: Bright Data provides REST API endpoints for web data collection and SERP scraping.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Use the Bright Data SERP API (31 languages) to extract structured results from Google, Bing, Yandex and DuckDuckGo with organic listings, ads and shopping data.
